plugin.name: Xiaohongshu
plugin.description: Search Xiaohongshu notes through a local xiaohongshu-mcp server, with a source agent.
source.xiaohongshu.name: Xiaohongshu
source.xiaohongshu.description: Xiaohongshu notes: searches by keyword, note details with comments, and authors' profiles. Needs the local xiaohongshu-mcp server (MCP server id "xiaohongshu") and a QR sign-in.
source.xiaohongshu.setup:
1. Download and run xiaohongshu-mcp on this computer (it listens on http://localhost:18060/mcp).
2. In Settings → MCP servers, add a server with id "xiaohongshu", type HTTP and that address.
3. Come back here and choose Sign in to scan the code. Only one device can be signed in to the account.
